Chapter 6931: Lesser Than Insects

Chapter 6931: Lesser Than Insects

Perpetual Immortal, as a direct disciple, had inherited Break Immortal’s skills. However, he wasn’t as murderous as his master, nor did he crave treasures like his first brother.

Of course, this was relative since he and his followers had committed heinous atrocities before. This was just the reality in a world with powerful cultivators. They wielded too much potential for destruction.

A fight between immortals could destroy a dozen minor worlds and all of their inhabitants. Fortunately, this didn’t happen too often.

In a sense, most mortals would have the privilege of living and dying, potentially passing down their bloodline before an apocalypse.

Furthermore, time was finite since the high heaven would also send down the ultimate tribulation, reducing all worlds to the starting point. Therefore, destruction seemed inevitable. It was a matter of who.

Regular people couldn’t grasp the calamity until it was too late. However, they did witness the good deeds of some immortals.

For example, an immortal could grant a great fortune to a minor world. If one were to die, the corpse would nourish the land with incredible resources.

The majority of immortals didn’t purposely cause disaster or bless worlds. After all, worlds were inconsequential in their eyes. Instead, they left administration to overlords and weaker cultivators.

When immortals lived long enough, they eventually gained strange tendencies and personalities.

For example, Breaker Immortal had a terrible temper. As for Treasure Immortal Lord, he liked to collect things, worlds included.

As for Perpetual, he and his followers often left nothing in their wake. Seeing the galaxy often meant destruction.

The galaxy had just ended a battle, hence entering this spatial dimension to rest.

Suddenly, two figures appeared.

“Who?!” Members of galaxy were alarmed and struck their gongs. Five immortals appeared immediately.

“Brothers, excuse us but we wish to see Perpetual Immortal.” Timeflow spoke.

“Lord of the Stars.” One of the five, Brave General, frowned and said: “Our Lord is not entertaining guests, please leave.”

Anyone else would have been killed but Lord of the Stars, or Timeflow, was Heaven’s Equal Immortal Monarch’s granddisciple.

“I’m afraid we can’t comply. This immortal here has an important matter...” Timeflow shook his head.

Li Qiye patted his shoulder and said: “Today, this galaxy shall be reduced to ashes. I will give you all the chance to attack first.”

The five immortals exchanged glances of confusion upon seeing the mortal.

“Destroy our galaxy? This mortal is hilarious!” One of them laughed.

“Opportunity gone.” Li Qiye raised his hand.

The five didn’t take him seriously at all.

“Hahaha, we’ll stand still for you to hit us...” One said.

Alas, they stopped laughing soon enough. They were sensitive to the call of death after numerous battles and now, they sensed it again.

“Shit, get ready!” They roared and prepared their best weapons and techniques.

“Bam!” Unfortunately, Li Qiye’s hand crushed everything and sent them like meteors through the galaxy. The impact separated the galaxy into several parts.

“Ahh!” Screams from the victims devastated by the chaos. The severing caused stars to explode, leaving no survivors.

As for the five generals, they had been pulverized by the slap before they could scream. Their true fate was destroyed as well.
